references.text: John the Baptist's ministry and message were foretold by the prophet Isaiah as a voice in the wilderness, emphasizing the heavenly origin and divine authorization of his service.
Describes John the Baptist's ministry, his baptism and call to repentance, as well as his pointing to Jesus as the Lamb of God, indicating a heavenly origin for his service.
Zechariah's prophecy concerning his son John points to his future role as the forerunner of the Lord, suggesting a divine plan and origin for his service.
Provides a detailed account of John the Baptist's ministry, his call to repentance and baptism, along with his testimony about Jesus, underscoring the heavenly approval of his service.
Mark's description of John the Baptist, his baptism and preaching, as well as his role in preparing the way for Jesus, points to the heavenly authorization of his service.
